single.rationale: Sally Beauty shows improving financial discipline with debt reduction ($119M), strong FCF generation ($173M, 4.7% margin), and margin expansion (operating margin up 130bps to 8.9%), but faces persistent revenue headwinds with flat-to-negative growth over three years and ongoing macro uncertainty affecting consumer behavior. The attractive valuation (7.5x P/E, 11.7% FCF yield) and capital allocation (buybacks, debt paydown) warrant monitoring, though the lack of topline momentum prevents an immediate deep dive.
